2608.27391.title: CorporateBench: Large-Scale Q&A Benchmarking with Temporal Knowledge Bases
2608.27391.paper_summary: LLMs are increasingly able to answer complex questions about enterprise-scale document collections. But evaluation is hard: companies don't want to share internal communications, and synthetic datasets have been overly simple. We present CorporateBench (CB), a human-validated multi-task Q&A benchmark whose scale approaches the conditions LLMs encounter in corporate communication networks, with evaluation corpora surpassing 230,000 documents. CB evaluates LLMs across two dimensions (information extraction and knowledge base querying) through four synthetically generated firms ranging from 12 to 10,000 employees. Each corpus is sampled from a temporally evolving knowledge base describing a consistent world, guaranteeing cross-document logical consistency even across hundreds of thousands of documents. We evaluate five LLMs on CB, revealing increasingly poor performance as input size approaches realistic scales. CB provides LLM developers a metric for corporate communication reasoning, filling a crucial gap in the benchmarking ecosystem.
2608.27391.paper_summary_zh: LLMs 越來越能夠回答有關企業級文件集合的複雜問題。<lb/>但評估是困難的：公司不願意分享內部通信，而合成數據集則過於簡單。<lb/>我們提出了 CorporateBench (CB)，這是一個經過人工驗證的多任務問答基準，其規模接近 LLMs 在企業通信網絡中遇到的條件，評估語料庫超過 230,000 份文件。<lb/>CB 通過四個合成生成的公司來評估 LLMs，這些公司員工數從 12 到 10,000 不等，涵蓋了兩個維度（信息提取和知識庫查詢）。<lb/>每個語料庫都來自一個隨時間演變的知識庫，描述了一個一致的世界，保證了跨文件的邏輯一致性，即使在數十萬份文件中也是如此。<lb/>我們在 CB 上評估了五個 LLMs，顯示出隨著輸入大小接近現實規模，性能逐漸下降。<lb/>CB 為 LLM 開發者提供了一個企業通信推理的指標，填補了基準生態系統中的一個關鍵空白。
